extra.message: The user-supplied q query parameter is interpolated directly into an LDAP filter: `(cn=*${term}*)`. Unlike findStaffMemberByEmail (which calls directoryClient.escapeFilter), this handler performs no escaping, so an attacker can inject LDAP filter metacharacters (e.g. `*)(mail=*`) to manipulate the directory search and enumerate or retrieve arbitrary entries.

extra.message: applyBureauRiskCallback is registered without authenticate/requireRole (line 245) and trusts the caller-controlled x-vendor-tier header plus result.access from the request body (line 232). Any unauthenticated attacker can send `x-vendor-tier: trusted` with `{"access": true, "riskTier": "low"}` to fast-track and rewrite the risk tier of any loan application, bypassing underwriting controls.

cwe: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function

extra.message: Handlebars.compile(bodyTemplate) is called on the attacker-supplied bodyTemplate request body and then executed. extra.message: The underwriter-supplied `shorthand` is interpolated directly into the LLM instruction prompt. The safe draft-risk-memo handler passes the shorthand as user-turn data with an explicit system instruction instead.

extra.message: The x-preview-format request header is read directly into targetFormat and interpolated unquoted into exec(`pandoc "${document.filePath}" -o "${outputPath}" -t ${targetFormat}`). An attacker can inject shell metacharacters (e.g. `pdf; touch /tmp/pwned`) to execute arbitrary OS commands on the server.

extra.message: The document_title query parameter is placed unvalidated into the Content-Disposition header (`filename="${requestedTitle}.txt"`). extra.message: The CRM API key is embedded in the URL query string (`...?api_key=${crmApiKey}&business_name=...`).
